title: Texture & Stability Ingredients
short_message: This product contains additives for texture, thickness, or stability. Often a sign of higher processing.
what_detected: BOTIA found: modified starch, starch, carrageenan (E407), guar gum, xanthan gum, gums, thickeners, stabilizers, or fillers. These are used to give body, thicken, stabilize water content, or improve mouthfeel.
why_it_matters: These ingredients signal that the product is formulated rather than simple. A fruit yogurt with xanthan gum and modified starch is more processed than plain yogurt. A 'fresh' sauce with carrageenan is stabilized to extend shelf life. Not inherently bad, but worth noticing if you prefer less-processed foods.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot tell you if these additives are harmful, if the product is unhealthy, or if it's right for your diet. Only that the product is more formulaic than basic versions.
source_note: Texture additives are regulated food ingredients. Presence is factual; interpretation is yours.
